name: turn-stats
description: A mod that shows a toast after long main-loop turns with the duration, output tokens and cache hit rate (`turn 3m12s · 41k out · cache 92%`).

thresholdSeconds.title: Toast after (seconds)
thresholdSeconds.description: Show the toast only for turns at least this long. 0 toasts after every turn.

includeAborted.title: Include interrupted turns
includeAborted.description: Also toast after a long turn you interrupted.
